page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the c4 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 30.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB per core, and includes a 137 GB local NVMe SSD for fast local storage.

The underlying Intel Xeon processor operates at a base speed of 2.3 GHz and features a large 504 MB L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations. In benchmark testing, the server demonstrates strong single-threaded performance, particularly in gzip compression and text processing, where it ranks in the top tier. General compute benchmarks, such as Geekbench and stress-ng, place the instance in the average performance tier.

While cached memory read bandwidth is high at 668.21 GB/sec, uncached large-block memory read performance and overall Passmark memory scores fall into the lower 25th percentile, representing a potential bottleneck for memory-intensive workloads. However, the integrated 137 GB local NVMe SSD provides high-speed, low-latency storage, making the instance highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring fast temporary storage without the overhead of network-attached disks.

Given its balanced CPU-to-memory ratio, dedicated core allocation, and local NVMe storage, this server is well-suited for general-purpose applications, web serving, software compilation, text processing, and lightweight database operations. It is also capable of handling small-scale language model inference, showing strong text generation speeds for smaller models.
